en.title: The bench at the end of the pier
en.excerpt: A wooden bench, a low tide, and an afternoon with nowhere else to be.
en.content:
A wooden bench, a low tide, and an afternoon with nowhere else to be. The pier extends further than it looks from shore. By the time you reach the end, the town feels like a suggestion.

I sat on the bench and watched the harbour empty itself. Boats left. Gulls arrived. The light changed without announcement.

Some places do not ask anything of you. This is one of them.
en.author: June Marsk
